confirm_again: Please answer yes to go ahead or no to cancel.
identity_failed: I'm sorry, those details do not match our records. Could you check the phone number and send it again?
order_status_in_transit: Your order {order_id} is {status}. It is expected on {date}.
confirm_action_create_return: I can set up a return for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_create_exchange: I can set up an exchange for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_create_refund: I can refund EGP {amount} for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_cancel_order: I can cancel order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_update_delivery_address: I can change the delivery address of order {order_id} to: {address}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_apply_voucher: I can give you a voucher of EGP {amount} for order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_create_ticket: I can open a support ticket about order {order_id}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
confirm_action_default: I can do this for you: {action}. Shall I go ahead? (yes/no)
action_cancelled: Okay, I won't do that. Is there anything else I can help with?
action_failed: Sorry, I could not complete that. Nothing was changed on your order.
policy_denied: I'm sorry, I can't do that under our policy.
approval_pending: This needs approval from our customer care team. I have sent them your request and a colleague will get back to you.
action_changed: Something changed on your order since I asked, so I have not done anything. Please tell me again what you would like.
